procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Diabetes follow-up
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Routine diabetes visit. Doing fine. Metformin twice daily, occasionally forgets the evening dose on weekends. No lows, no polyuria. Says she still hasn't booked this year's eye exam; gave her the optometry number again.

Exam: vitals as charted. Alert, well. Cardiac and lung exams normal. Feet: intact skin, normal sensation.

Assessment/plan: T2DM, controlled. A1c and BMP today. Continue metformin 500 mg twice daily; talked about a pill box or phone alarm for the evening dose. Yearly physical with Pap and full labs in November.

documents.title: A1c
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: A1c is 6.5 and kidney tests are normal. Steady. See you in November.

documents.title: Metformin refill
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Pharmacy request: metformin 500 mg #180, 1 tab BID. Seen 5/14, A1c 6.5. Sent 90 days + 1 refill.

reports.text:
Specimen: cervical, liquid-based preparation, collected in office. Specimen adequacy: satisfactory for evaluation; endocervical/transformation zone component present.
Interpretation: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.
reports.conclusion: Negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Yearly physical, 25 y/o. Feels well. No new concerns.

Diabetes: on metformin 500 mg BID, using a phone alarm now and rarely misses. No lows. Had her eye exam over the summer at the same optometry office and was told everything looked fine; we don't have the report, front desk to request it.

Meds: metformin 500 mg BID. NKDA.
PSH: none.
FHx: mother T2DM, father HTN.
Social: admin assistant, same job. Lives with partner. Never smoker. Alcohol only occasionally.
PHQ-2: 0.

Exam: Vitals as charted. NAD. HEENT normal. Neck supple, no thyromegaly. RRR without murmur. Lungs CTA. Abdomen soft, nontender. Pelvic: normal external genitalia, vaginal mucosa normal, cervix without lesions; Pap collected. Skin without lesions of concern. No edema. Diabetic foot exam: skin and nails normal, pulses palpable, monofilament normal bilaterally.

A/P
1. T2DM, well controlled. A1c, CMP, lipid panel, urine albumin/creatinine. Continue metformin as is.
2. Cervical screening: Pap today, cytology only at her age.
3. Vaccines: flu and this season's COVID given today.
4. Eye exam report requested from optometry.

RTC 6 months for diabetes.

documents.title: Pap and bloodwork
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Hi Yolanda, everything from Friday is back. Your Pap is normal; next one in three years. A1c 6.4, the best it's been since you started here. Kidney, liver, urine and cholesterol results are all normal.

We asked the eye doctor's office to send over the summer exam. Please book a diabetes check for around May.
